steps.name: specification
steps.title: Draft specification and plan
steps.instructions: Inspect the project and task brief. Develop spec.html and plan.html using your linked skills; report material questions and limitations. Use Go planning evidence for consequential API and concurrency claims. Keep documents proportional to the task; edit content bodies with the shared renderer. On revision, address stable finding IDs and publish the changed documents with revision references.

steps.name: architecture_review
steps.title: Review specification and plan
steps.instructions: Critically review the current spec.html and plan.html against the task brief and project. Return completed only when no material changes are needed; return changes_requested with actionable findings otherwise. Write findings and verdict to reviews/architecture.md. Establish independent coverage on the first review. Later review actual revisions, open findings, and affected contracts, then cross-check current spec/plan consistency. Consolidate findings with stable IDs and reviewed revisions.

steps.name: build
steps.title: Implement approved plan
steps.instructions: Implement the approved spec and plan in the project root. Run relevant checks, record progress and evidence, and hand off the changes for independent review. Write commands, results, changed files, and limitations to reviews/build.md. Keep coherent plan-item progress and bounded check evidence. Resolve review findings against actual source; publish the revised work with finding resolutions.

steps.name: code_review
steps.title: Review implementation
steps.instructions: Independently review the implementation against the approved spec and plan. Return completed when the work meets them; return changes_requested with concrete findings otherwise. Write findings, verification evidence, and verdict to reviews/code.md. First review independently; subsequent rounds inspect actual changes, open findings, and affected invariants. Reuse valid evidence, expand checks when repairs warrant it, and finish with current acceptance coverage.
